title: Dynamics 365 Business Central Blog Series: Integrate Business Central with OneDrive
summary: A blog series covering multiple approaches to integrate Business Central with OneDrive, including file import and export via AL and Graph API, report saving, Power Automate workflows for automated syncing, and native features like Edit in OneDrive and file sharing. The series explains both custom development methods and no-code automation options for handling files and data between Business Central and OneDrive.
key_points: File operations between Business Central and OneDrive can be performed using AL code with Graph API, including import, upload, and report saving
Power Automate offers no-code solutions to synchronize files and data between OneDrive and Business Central
Native OneDrive features in Business Central include Edit in OneDrive, Share action, and cloud file configuration
Custom actions can be implemented to extend OneDrive integration capabilities within Business Central
Data exchange between systems supports multiple formats including CSV, JSON, and file attachments

quotes.text: How to import/read files from OneDrive to Business Central via AL (Graph API)
quotes.why_it_matters: Demonstrates the core use case of programmatically accessing OneDrive files within Business Central using AL code

quotes.text: How to automatically upload files from OneDrive to Business Central with Power Automate (No customization)
quotes.why_it_matters: Shows no-code automation approach that doesn't require AL development, making OneDrive sync accessible to users without coding skills
